Jul 2026 • Business
Had a wonderful dining experience at Sear Steakhouse in Vietnam! The steak was perfectly cooked to our requested medium well, the doneness was spot on. It was juicy, savory, and full of flavor in every bite.

What really stood out was the wide selection of sauces and side dishes, making it easy to customize the meal to your taste. Everything paired beautifully with the steak and made the experience even more enjoyable.

If you’re looking for a great steak with excellent flavor and plenty of options to make it your own, Sear Steakhouse is definitely worth a visit. Highly recommended!

Hidden Gem
Mar 2026 • Family
While on a family holiday in Ho Chi Minh City, my wife wasn’t quite up for diving into the usual Vietnamese street food scene. Having been a chef herself once upon a time, she was really craving a refined dining experience—somewhere she could relax and enjoy great food without the hustle and bustle (and street aromas!) outside.
Sear Steakhouse delivered exactly that.
From the moment we arrived, the atmosphere was calm and polished, setting the tone for a fantastic evening. Our waiter, Khoa, was incredibly attentive without being overbearing—he struck the perfect balance and made us feel very well looked after throughout the meal.
The steak was the true highlight—cooked to absolute perfection and wonderfully tender. Every bite was spot on, and you could really tell care and skill went into the preparation.
Overall, the entire experience was smooth, relaxing, and thoroughly enjoyable. Sear Steakhouse exceeded our expectations and definitely did not disappoint. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a quality dining experience in Ho Chi Minh City!
